trigger: an off-rule, an undetermined fact or lost state covers a quarantine action on an endpoint with an active containment record
classification_rationale: D3 'no internal route around an off unit' versus the shipped invariant that release must never be blocked by the containment it lifts (dispatch_confined_arms.hpp:182,659; security-hardening.md:565; reconciler counts a withheld send as not_reached)
summary: D3 made every unit switchable with no bypass and never mentioned protective state, so a switch-off could strand a contained device or remove the channel that would switch it back on. Reported independently by security-guardian (SG-1), unhappy-path (UP-2), architect (A8b) and sre (F2 tail); dsl-engineer DSL-4 adds the self-latching rule. The orchestrator verified the invariant and the manual text on origin/dev. fixed in feedcb696: D3 states that recovering a protective state and the control channel are never units and that a rule cannot switch off a unit feeding its own selector; D11 preview lists protective state an off-rule would stop re-applying; D14 does not refuse recovery; Verification 16; Q7 narrowed deliberately (disclosed to the product owner).

trigger: enablement store restored from an older backup or rebuilt empty while agents hold newer state; or an agent's state files absent (reimage, restore, cleanup) with no way to tell 'lost' from 'never held'
classification_rationale: D14 covered only an unreadable store and unreadable agent copies; 'never held state uses its starting state' made missing files read as never-held, and a restored store would push the more-on state fleet-wide with no preview or audit
summary: A readable-but-wrong store or absent agent state failed open, contradicting D14's own direction and Verification 2. Reported independently by sre (F1), unhappy-path (UP-1, UP-11) and security-guardian (SG-7a). fixed in feedcb696: D14 treats absent state as lost, records that state was held with the enrolment and on the server, a store behind its agents switches nothing on and says it regressed, an agent told the control plane is unavailable holds switchable units off, the state is in the server's backups; D6 one durable shared store for every replica and not-ready without it; Verification 17.

trigger: the roadmap builds D7/D11 purge as an enablement-plane act with selector reach under the enablement permission alone
classification_rationale: D11 'a permission of its own ... no second approver' and D7 purge versus D2 'gates untouched' and the existing tar.purge_source (Destructive/Irreversible, Infrastructure:Delete, typed confirmation, explicit agent_ids, #3685)
summary: Purge had no stated permission or gates and D11 read as replacing the existing destructive controls. Reported independently by security-guardian (SG-2) and compliance-officer (C-1; native MEDIUM, derived HIGH). fixed in feedcb696: D7 and D11 state that deleting stored data is the existing destructive action under its own permission, targeting and confirmation and that the enablement permission neither grants nor replaces them; Verification 18.

trigger: carry-over (D9), first-contact adoption (D8), release additions (D10), attribute drift (D12) or lost state (D14) change what an endpoint collects with no operator acting; 'cannot audit => does not happen' is unsatisfiable for them and would flip shipped-off units on at carry-over
classification_rationale: D11 audited only operator changes; D12 said 'recorded'; Verification 9 said every change is audited; the product owner's Q11 ruling was 'audited with its cause'
summary: The audit contract lacked principal and surface, from-to, reason and previewed scope, left system-made changes outside the trail, and D12 weakened the ruling to 'recorded'. Reported by compliance-officer (C-2, C-3), security-guardian (SG-4, SG-7b), unhappy-path (UP-4) and happy-path (HP-7). fixed in feedcb696: D11 states the record content, system actor with a cause link, operator changes refuse when unauditable and system changes resolve toward less collection, history kept as long as the audit trail; D12 audits both directions with the attribute's source class; Verification 9, 15, 21. Switching off during an audit outage is stated as a residual and an open question (decision for the product owner).

trigger: ostype==linux AND NOT tag:lab==yes (D4's own example) on a Linux endpoint whose lab fact is not yet known; the evaluator is two-valued (scope_engine.hpp:71,74) so 'unknown leaf = true' makes NOT invert and the unit stays on
classification_rationale: D5 gave the polarity (treated as matching) but not the semantics, so implementers read it three ways with opposite results on the ADR's own example; Guardian's reconcile collapses an unreadable read to 'not a member', which is fail-open for an off-rule
summary: D5's undetermined sentence was ambiguous at the granularity that matters. Reported by dsl-engineer (DSL-1; native SHOULD, derived HIGH), with happy-path (HP-9) and unhappy-path (UP-3) on adjacent aspects. The orchestrator verified the evaluator is two-valued on origin/dev. fixed in feedcb696: D5 settles by known facts (false AND operand or true OR operand settles, negation of unknown is unknown, a final unknown matches), unset is not unknown, stale keeps its last value with its age, unreadable is a control-plane fault; the rejected list gains 'any unknown anywhere'; Verification 19.

trigger: an operator disables then re-enables netconn, or switches a carried-over source on while look-back is on by default
classification_rationale: D7 'never fills in the time it was off' versus the deliberately kept netconn high-water mark (test-pinned, test_tar_aggregator.cpp:553) and ADR-0020's 7-day first read; D3 look-back could be built as a read on re-enable, which would breach the cursor-source row
summary: D7 and D3 contradicted each other and a pinned feature. Reported by architect (A1), unhappy-path (UP-6), happy-path (HP-5), consistency-auditor (C3) and docs-writer (DW-2b). fixed in feedcb696: look-back applies to a source's first baseline on an endpoint and to recovery a source already does by design; re-enable and lost position resume from the present and record the gap; depth unchanged; the retrofit list names the connection source's recovery.

trigger: server upgrade with endpoints that hold per-agent capture flags the server never held; re-imaged or re-enrolled endpoints; rolling upgrade skew; rollback
classification_rationale: D9 'whatever was on stays on, marked carried over' versus Context fact 2 (the server does not hold per-agent capture state) and V5; carry-over key and re-enrolment undefined; an upgraded agent had no defined starting state
summary: Carry-over could not be server-derived and its key was undefined. Reported by consistency-auditor (C1), architect (A4), happy-path (HP-1, HP-2), enterprise-readiness (ER-3), sre (F7) and unhappy-path (UP-8). fixed in feedcb696: carry-over is of each endpoint's actual state taken from the agent through the D8 path, untouched until then, visible count of endpoints not yet carried over, re-image or re-enrol is a new installation, skew tolerated, return to the previous mechanism stays possible; D14 and the Terminology treat an upgraded agent's existing flags as its starting state.

trigger: a release manager reads Consequences and ships default-on with only D8; the introducing release adds the missing Windows plugins (#4867) before any additions setting can exist
classification_rationale: the ship-with-D8 rule lived outside the Decision, named D8 only, and sat beside 'delivery order belongs to the roadmap'; D10's setting cannot pre-exist its own introducing release
summary: Reported by enterprise-readiness (ER-1, ER-2), sre (F7) and docs-writer (DW-2e). fixed in feedcb696: D2 and `effective:` state that the new defaults ship only with enforcement, the deployment-time choice and carry-over, Verification 20; D10 makes the introducing release's additions arrive awaiting decision (author decision, disclosed to the product owner).

trigger: two implementers read D3/D6/D7/D9/D10/D13 and Verification 2/3/10 differently
classification_rationale: UP-7 (D6 'server accepts nothing' versus D7 'irreversible work recorded'), UP-5 (retention and purge as unit work versus D3 'no internal route'), DW-2a (D3 fallback wording versus D14), DW-2c/HP-8 (D9 versus D10 widening), DW-2d (awaiting decision as provenance), V2/V3/V10 over-quantified, C4/DW-2g/UP-14 (D13 reason versus status, no 'failed to load'), UP-9/UP-10 (additions under skew, setting flip)
summary: Wording-level contradictions that change what gets built, reported by docs-writer, unhappy-path, happy-path, consistency-auditor and architect. fixed in feedcb696: one clause each; D13 now carries one reason from a closed list plus statuses, 'failed to load' added, the Terminology defines every state and the additions setting; Verification 2, 3, 5, 10 corrected.

trigger: a unit goes off (operator, attribute drift or undetermined) mid-incident; a daily-sync source is switched off
classification_rationale: D7 retired the pause-as-forensic-preservation behaviour (tar-dashboard.md 3.4) without saying so; central daily-sync rows have no retention and an off source ages into the stale-agent gauge
summary: Reported by compliance-officer (C-4) and architect (A2, A3). fixed in feedcb696: retention is not unit work, lost state prunes nothing until resynchronised, an off sync source is reported off and its refusal acknowledged without need_full, the central copy is kept and marked, and the loss of the hold is an accepted residual.

trigger: mass upgrade, enrolment or state loss at 100k+ endpoints; one rule edit over the fleet; control-plane outage while schedules, approvals and ingest run
classification_rationale: 'asks for it at once' with fail-closed dispatch can herd and loop; refusal semantics for scheduled work and ingest unstated; D15 bounded cost per change but not one change; the scope evaluator's presence read aborts above kQueryRowCap (offline_endpoint_store.hpp:25,99); no fleet-level signals
summary: Reported by sre (F2-F5), architect (A5) and dsl-engineer (DSL-2, DSL-3). fixed in feedcb696: D6 reconnect reports the held version and resync is paced; D14 unavailability is a retryable cause; D15 paced resumable change-driven resolution, coalescing, preview not a capped read; D13 aggregates; the retrofit list names the provider registry, composable group atom, per-endpoint resolver and the evaluator's limits. Metric names and alerts stay with the roadmap.

trigger: RBAC off (shipped default) with a non-admin; an enrolled agent presents a starting state; the default-off safeguard is relaxed for the three plugins without re-arguing it
classification_rationale: D11 did not state the RBAC-off write floor or the read side; D8 adoption had no trust boundary; the 'must be made again' paragraph named three plugins only and listed 'bounded reads' while #5057 is open
summary: Reported by security-guardian (SG-3, SG-5, SG-6). fixed in feedcb696: D11 states holders role-agnostically, the administrator floor where access control is off and existing read gating; D8 adoption is once, claimant-scoped, reduce-only, labelled and never overrides an operator; the Consequences paragraph requires the invariant and README amendments in the same reviewed change, extends to the capture sources readable through the query actions, and closes #5057 first.

trigger: a control owner quotes the Summary in a questionnaire, or a reader of ADR-0015/0020/3005 trusts the amendment note
classification_rationale: Summary and the three amendment notes stated a proposal as shipped fact ('capture sources ship on', 'no longer seeded off') while effective: says nothing changes on merge and server.cpp:5108/5127/5144 still seed three plugins off
summary: Reported by compliance-officer (C-5), docs-writer (DW-1), architect (A7), consistency-auditor (C6) and enterprise-readiness (ER-5). fixed in feedcb696: Summary opens 'a direction, not current behaviour' and uses future tense; the three notes are rewritten 'Amendment pending ... nothing has changed in the product yet', ADR-3005's note names 'REST authorization - existing operations only' and ADR-0015's names the staged-then-push guardrail.

trigger: the roadmap implements D3/D7 literally against ADR-0021 Decision 11 and the Spark flip-gate rollback ruling (boot-time, restart-required) and ADR-0016 line 336
classification_rationale: neither ADR nor the ruling appeared in `amends` and neither carried a note; the engine's stop() is sticky and wire_spark_engine is once-at-boot
summary: Reported by consistency-auditor (C2), with architect (A8a) on the sticky stop. fixed in feedcb696: `amends` extended, pending notes added to ADR-0016 and ADR-0021, the retrofit list requires a runtime arm and disarm path that does not use the engine's sticky stop.

trigger: the retrofit lands and statements elsewhere still call sources opt-in or off by default
classification_rationale: the retrofit list covered only the three plugin seeds and their documents; nine further location groups (tar-implementer, user manual, tar definition, capability matrix, SOC 2 inventory, daily-sync and Spark notes) and #539's 'disabling leaves rows queryable' were not named
summary: Reported by consistency-auditor (C5), compliance-officer (SOC 2 inventory rows) and enterprise-readiness (ER-4). fixed in feedcb696: a catch-all bullet naming the groups, the retention-paused frame this ADR retires, the connection source's recovery, the operator upgrade guide and release notes.

trigger: a reader of the front matter or Terminology
classification_rationale: DW-3 and DW-4: 'To be ratified' goes stale at merge, undefined 'collector', two names for the catalogue, 'additions setting' unnamed, three states defined only in passing, #5372/#5375 over-included, D8 and risk-table 'before anything is collected'/'immediately' overstate, context-refs lacked three cited documents
summary: docs-writer DW-3 and DW-4. fixed in feedcb696: deciders wording, context-refs extended, 'collector' removed, 'enablement catalogue' used throughout, additions setting and the eight statuses defined, issue range corrected, D8 lead and risk-table wording corrected.

trigger: a reader asks what moves a proposed ADR to accepted
classification_rationale: docs/adr/README.md defines no status vocabulary and 7 other ADRs are `proposed` on dev; adding a transition process would be inventing policy outside this ADR's scope
summary: docs-writer DW-3 suggested a clause on what moves this ADR to accepted. Rejected: no repository status vocabulary exists to cite and the ADR is not the place to create one.

trigger: a reader looks for the roadmap the ADR defers to
classification_rationale: no issue or document for the roadmap exists yet; ADR-3002's #2380 precedent cites an existing issue, which does not exist here
summary: docs-writer DW-3 asked for a repo-visible handle for 'the roadmap'. Rejected: citing one would invent a reference to something not yet raised (PR bodies and ADRs must not reference unraised work).

trigger: a reader checks Q7 coverage against the D3 unit list
classification_rationale: the net-quality heartbeat sampler rides --dex-disable (agent.cpp:2860), so it is covered by the DEX signals unit; consistency-auditor verified this on origin/dev
summary: happy-path HP-10 said the heartbeat net-quality sampler has no unit. Rejected: consistency-auditor traced it to the DEX start-up flag, so D3's coverage list is complete.

trigger: a solutions reader quotes 'Off becomes true on the endpoint'; a customer reads 'reduced set' as custom installs going away; a pilot customer relies on delegated administration
classification_rationale: ER-5 over-promising sentences, ER-6 D8 mistyped unit and per-endpoint adoption, ER-7 installer wording, ER-8 delegated admins not visible in the residuals
summary: enterprise-readiness ER-5 to ER-8. fixed in feedcb696: future tense and 'on every agent that enforces state', D8 adoption scoped, custom and minimal installs stated as a supported choice, delegated administration by management group listed as an accepted residual and an open question.

trigger: a reader checks Verification 2 against the residuals, the scope kinds against D5, or the ADR against ADR-1005
classification_rationale: C7 Verification 2 overclaimed (old agents, irreversible actions); C8 group:<name> is an existing scope kind, 'per-user' on a machine-scope plugin, Guardian rules and definition flags without a decision, D1 versus the five never-offered Windows plugins; C9 no statement that the surface is reachable by REST and MCP
summary: consistency-auditor C7, C8, C9. fixed in feedcb696: Verification 2 scoped to enforcing agents, management-group membership described as a composable attribute, 'per-user' dropped, authored content added as a non-goal, never-offered plugins arrive under D10, D13 states REST and MCP reachability per ADR-1005.

trigger: a roadmap author builds from the ADR
classification_rationale: A6 Guardian's generation is one fleet-wide counter; A8 Spark sticky stop, the state channel is not a unit, a widening ships as a new unit
summary: architect A6, A8. fixed in feedcb696: D6 says one version per endpoint, D3 says the control channel is not a unit, D10 says a widening is delivered as a new unit, the retrofit list says engines need a runtime path.

trigger: a control owner writes the narrative from the ADR
classification_rationale: default holders unnamed, 'immutable audit' correctly not claimed (audit_store has no chain or HMAC), access review is roadmap
summary: compliance-officer C-6. fixed in feedcb696: D11 states the holders role-agnostically and the RBAC-off floor; no immutable-audit claim added; access review stays with the roadmap.

trigger: reordered or duplicate pushes, backup restore regressing versions, tag flapping on thousands of hosts, preview differing from apply
classification_rationale: UP-11 version authority, UP-12 drift churn, UP-13 preview not binding apply: mechanisms are roadmap, the decisions are not. The I3 facet of UP-11 (an older, more-on state adopted after a restore) is closed in g3006-k2, not here
summary: unhappy-path UP-11 to UP-13, closable at the roadmap per the reviewer. fixed in feedcb696: decision-level sentences only (D6 one durable shared store and per-endpoint version, D14 never pushes a weaker view over a stronger one, D15 coalescing, D11 the change applies the set that was shown or is shown again); mechanisms stay with the roadmap.
